content: The foolish old man who moved mountains did so by removing one stone at a time.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Yu gong yi shan (愚公移山) — Liezi (Classical Taoist Allegory)
explanation: In the classical Taoist allegory, the elder Yu Gong was mocked as a fool for trying to level two colossal mountains blocking his village path. He replied that though he might die, his children and grandchildren would continue, while the mountain could grow no taller. Unwavering persistence outlasts all obstacles.
practicalInsight: Break that seemingly impossible life goal down into a single stone today. Move that stone and ignore the skeptics.
reflectionPrompt: What mountain in your life are you avoiding because you cannot move it all in a single afternoon?
